title: Smeg — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Smeg.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Premium tier. Smeg is the Italian design icon — their FAB retro refrigerator is arguably the most recognizable appliance silhouette in the world. Founded in 1948 in Guastalla, Italy, Smeg collaborates with architects like Renzo Piano and designers like Dolce & Gabbana on limited editions. Their appliances are functional art that happens to cool food and cook meals. The retro lineup spans fridges, dishwashers, ranges, and small appliances.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-statement kitchens. Customers who choose appliances like furniture — form and identity first. Instagram-worthy kitchen builds.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Smeg:

• Most iconic appliance design in the world — the FAB fridge is instantly recognizable

• Italian craftsmanship since 1948 — made in Guastalla, Italy

• 8+ color options including pastels that no other brand offers

• Design collaborations with Dolce & Gabbana, Disney, Coca-Cola — collectible editions

• Matching small appliances (toasters, kettles, mixers) complete the design story
